ears_requirement: The system SHALL run as a self-hosted enterprise platform with isolated workspaces and multiple source registrations.
When a noncommercial AWS partition is registered, the system SHALL reject it with an explicit launch-scope outcome.
The system SHALL qualify a 3,000-account reference workload and characterize a 10,000-account stress workload without claiming untested capacity.
The system SHALL distinguish the declared inventory universe, provider limitations, product gaps, disabled opt-ins, and observed account permissions.

When a supported valid change hint is accepted, the system SHALL target refreshed or authoritatively confirmed unchanged state query-visible within five seconds; unresolved/failure outcomes SHALL be visible misses, not freshness successes.
While enabled, every supported expected scope SHALL complete successful reconciliation at least hourly; incomplete/denied/late scopes SHALL remain visible as breaches.
When a scope fails, the system SHALL retain its last known inventory with visible age/coverage while healthy scopes continue updating.
When absence is confirmed under the declared policy, the system SHALL mark deletion and preserve history; partial or denied enumeration SHALL NOT imply deletion.
The system SHALL collect configuration metadata and SHALL NOT retrieve application contents or secret values for inventory.
The system SHALL keep enterprise annotations distinct from immutable provider observations and SHALL NOT mutate AWS through CMDB editing.
When discovering an Organization, the system SHALL enumerate all pages and record account/OU membership with complete-list evidence.
When onboarding an account, the system SHALL verify caller account, partition, role, and enabled-region evidence before accepting inventory.
The system SHALL support explicitly configured existing roles, refreshable credentials, and standalone account registrations without storing session credentials.
When an account is removed or inaccessible, the system SHALL represent visibility loss separately from resource deletion.
The system SHALL produce reviewable least-privilege bootstrap plans and keep their application separate from inventory execution.
The system SHALL expose permission prerequisites, subscription requirements, region availability, source lag, and bootstrap drift per account.
The system SHALL execute global resources once per authoritative endpoint scope and preserve real resource ownership and region semantics.
When a role can list but cannot describe or tag a resource, the system SHALL retain partial evidence and explicit unavailable fields.
The system SHALL reuse SDK clients/credentials within validated account/region/lifetime boundaries and bound refresh work.
When region/account discovery is partial, the system SHALL NOT publish complete downstream coverage.
The system SHALL maintain the versioned AWS/provider/Steampipe/CloudQuery inventory-universe and compatibility matrices.
The system SHALL classify each SDK operation with evidence before treating it as a configuration inventory capability.
Each collector SHALL declare identity, scope, parent traversal, fields, tags, relationships, permissions, quotas, costs, and lifecycle semantics.
Each collector SHALL handle empty nonterminal pages, repeated tokens, invalid tokens, page limits, and parent failures explicitly.
The system SHALL preserve unavailable, missing, explicit null, absent, and redacted field states separately.
When provider/SDK/competitor catalogs change, the system SHALL report coverage drift without silently upgrading support claims.
The replacement release SHALL contain zero unexplained or product-unimplemented rows in its accepted launch universe.
The system SHALL publish resource, field, tag, relationship, event, and real-AWS qualification coverage separately.
The system SHALL record external-seed requirements for nonenumerable APIs and explicit opt-ins for chargeable/operational feeds.
The system SHALL retain collector/schema/policy versions with observations and compatibility views.
The system SHALL persist bounded collector-segment and refresh work independently of whole-account scan invocations.
When a worker claims work, the system SHALL issue a monotonically fenced lease using one conditional durable transaction.
When ownership expires, stale workers SHALL NOT commit accepted pages, checkpoints, or terminal outcomes.
When a worker restarts, the system SHALL resume validated checkpoints or begin a separately evidenced epoch under the collector's restart policy.
The system SHALL coordinate actual shared AWS quota domains across hosts and workspaces observing the same account.
Every explicit provider attempt SHALL consume the applicable rate/concurrency budget, including retries.
When ownership transfers, the system SHALL retain cooldown/rate state and bound already-dispatched request overlap.
The system SHALL use one classified provider retry owner with finite attempt/time budgets and validated server retry hints.
The scheduler SHALL prevent hot accounts, event bursts, and backfill from starving hourly reconciliation.
The system SHALL bound tasks, channels, pending work, payloads, memory, and connections and expose saturation.
When change events arrive, the system SHALL authenticate source binding and persist receipts/intents before acknowledgement.
When events duplicate or reorder, the system SHALL coalesce refresh work while retaining causal receipt linkage and preventing state regression.
When an event mapping is unknown or poisonous, the system SHALL quarantine it with bounded retry and expose a coverage/freshness problem.
The system SHALL reconcile hourly independently of event availability or delivery guarantees.
When cancellation or lease loss occurs, the system SHALL stop intake, cancel, drain, and finalize with an explicit bounded outcome.
Successful page acceptance SHALL atomically persist observations, page identity, checkpoint, coverage effects, and outbox intent.
Successful receipt acceptance SHALL atomically persist the receipt and refresh intent before upstream acknowledgement.
When a page/commit is replayed, unique idempotency constraints SHALL prevent duplicate logical state and detect conflicting payloads.
When commit outcome is ambiguous, the system SHALL resolve by idempotency lookup before retrying publication.
The system SHALL retain authoritative identifiers, unresolved references, owner evidence, aliases, and incarnation uncertainty.
Current-field selection SHALL account for freshness, capture time, authority, visibility, and comparable ordering, rather than fixed source priority alone.
Hybrid resources SHALL expose field-level provenance and distinct provider/receipt/observation timestamps.
Absence sweeps SHALL respect the epoch cutoff, exact population, principal visibility class, and later reobservations.
Confirmed deletion SHALL require two separated successful complete epochs or a reviewed equivalent resource-specific policy.
Relationship removal SHALL require completeness of that source's relationship population and preserve historical assertions.
Projectors SHALL apply idempotent entity versions and publish only contiguous/gap-accounted completeness watermarks.
When a graph/search sink fails, observations SHALL remain durable and bounded projection backlog/lag SHALL be visible.
Projection rebuilds SHALL validate in a separate namespace before atomic publication and retain rollback capability.
Retention SHALL verify archives and respect holds, replay horizons, tombstone safety, and audit policy before deleting evidence.
Storage migrations/imports SHALL preserve declared compatibility and verify provenance/counts/state; foreign/newer schemas SHALL fail explicitly.
The system SHALL publish a versioned HTTPS API/OpenAPI contract and typed clients with coverage/version/freshness metadata.
List/search APIs SHALL enforce cursor-bound authorization, stable pagination, result bounds, and query expiry semantics.
Resource APIs SHALL expose current state, history/as-of, provenance, lifecycle, aliases, relationships, and coverage evidence.
Graph APIs SHALL enforce typed authorized traversals, depth/node/edge/byte limits, and explicit truncation.
Query execution SHALL use parsed supported read-only SQL, parameter binding, least-privilege storage roles, and execution limits.
Compatibility views SHALL document differences from the accepted AWS Steampipe/CloudQuery table/field universe.
The system SHALL support saved views/queries, scheduled reports, snapshot diffs, and cancellation of expensive work.
CMDB APIs SHALL support owners, teams, services/applications, custom fields, annotations, and user-created relationships.
Concurrent edits SHALL condition on expected revision and return a conflict without overwriting stored or pending user data.
Control mutations SHALL require semantic authorization and idempotency keys; accepted intent SHALL remain distinct from completion.
Subscription streams SHALL carry resume cursors and require a controlled snapshot reset after gaps/expiry.
Exports SHALL support versioned JSON/JSONL/CSV/Parquet with immutable manifests, counts, hashes, and authorized downloads.
Webhook delivery SHALL use authenticated bounded retries, receiver idempotency, safe destinations, and visible dead letters.
Public errors SHALL use stable safe codes and correlation IDs without leaking secrets or inaccessible object existence.
The UI SHALL provide fleet coverage/freshness, onboarding, inventory, resource history, graph, CMDB editing, reports, and operations surfaces.
The UI SHALL use server-filtered virtualized tables and bounded GPU graph views rather than loading the full estate.
Graph rendering SHALL use WebGL2-capable baseline behavior and capability-tested optional WebGPU with a usable fallback.
Layout/filter computation SHALL run off the main UI path with cancellation and version checks against obsolete results.
View updates SHALL be incremental and preserve navigation/selection where authorization permits.
When networking fails, the UI SHALL show retained data age and recover by resume/reset; when authorization is revoked it SHALL clear inaccessible state.
UI no-data, filtered-empty, denied, unsupported, stale, incomplete, deleted, and unresolved states SHALL remain distinct.
The UI SHALL meet declared frame/input/initial-view budgets on the reference client with labels and interactions enabled.
The UI SHALL provide keyboard/accessibility support, reduced motion, and equivalent relationship tables.
Browser/GPU context loss SHALL recover bounded resources without silently losing the user's allowed view.
Browser compatibility SHALL be qualified on named versions/capabilities and real interaction paths.
The UI SHALL expose projection lag and SHALL NOT describe stale graph state using a fresh inventory timestamp.
The platform SHALL support enterprise OIDC SSO, group/role mapping, expiring service identities, and audited break-glass recovery.
Workspace/account/field authorization SHALL apply to rows, counts, edges, exports, streams, caches, logs, and indirect access paths.
Database runtime roles SHALL be non-owner/non-superuser/non-BYPASSRLS, with tested transaction-local context and default-deny policy.
TLS/endpoint validation, encryption at rest, key rotation, and workload identity SHALL protect service/provider/storage boundaries.
Sensitive fields SHALL be classified/redacted before generic storage, logging, graph projection, cache, or export.
User/provider text SHALL be bounded and safely rendered without executing embedded content.
The platform SHALL enforce session, CSRF, CSP, CORS, stream-origin, request-limit, SSRF, and export-path controls appropriate to each boundary.
Authorization revocation SHALL invalidate affected server access, streams, cursors, downloads, and cached access decisions within 30 seconds; the supported UI SHALL clear inaccessible cached state.
Inventory roles SHALL remain read-only; infrastructure bootstrap SHALL use distinct explicit administrator authority.
Security/audit records SHALL attribute actor, workspace, action, policy/revision, result, and correlation without secret payloads.
Source/policy/retention/edit/export/replay/admin changes SHALL generate protected audit evidence.
Secrets/session credentials SHALL NOT be committed or persisted in work payloads, artifacts, logs, or user-facing errors.
Tenant-like workspace isolation SHALL be tested even though launch is one self-hosted enterprise rather than public SaaS.
A dependency finding SHALL retain its disposition and evidence; compilation SHALL NOT substitute for security review.
The platform SHALL ship reproducible local/emulator deployment and an HA enterprise deployment profile with pinned dependencies/images.
The platform SHALL publish sizing, topology, resource ceilings, network/IAM prerequisites, and explicit startup/readiness dependencies.
Operators SHALL receive bounded-cardinality metrics, traces, logs and dashboards for stage latency, scope freshness, quota, backlog and errors.
Freshness, visibility loss, saturation, lease churn, projection lag, archive/backup lag, and credential failure SHALL have actionable alerts.
Accepted state SHALL satisfy the declared HA durability policy, and failover SHALL preserve fencing and contiguous projection semantics.
Backups/PITR and archive manifests SHALL be verified through actual restore exercises with stated RPO/RTO evidence.
Upgrades SHALL support compatibility windows, canary rollout, explicit migrations, backfill monitoring and rollback boundaries.
Disaster, disk-full, poisoned events, lost credentials, partitioned workers, quota collapse and graph failure SHALL have tested runbooks.
Inventory history and archive retention SHALL be configurable by workspace with safe expiry and holds.
Capacity planning SHALL include full-enumeration API lower bounds, enrichment fanout, event churn, history, WAL, replicas and rebuild headroom.
The system SHALL expose configured cost/resource ceilings and SHALL NOT bypass quotas or durability to meet a freshness target.
Decommissioning SHALL preserve/export authorized evidence and explicitly revoke role/event/integration access under operator control.
New domain logic SHALL use parsed private-field types, explicit state transitions, semantic errors, and a pure core/async shell boundary.
First-party Rust SHALL forbid unsafe and unchecked panic constructs and obey the installed strict source/function/parameter policies.
Async work SHALL have task ownership, bounded admission, cancellation/drain/finalize outcomes, and observable capability-gated effects.
Every behavior SHALL map to independent executable acceptance evidence against production boundaries, not implementation-shaped assertions alone.
Applicable proof/model/fuzz/concurrency lanes SHALL be planned/reviewed and bridged to production source; unexecuted design SHALL NOT count as proof.
Manual QA, adversarial Red Queen campaigns, strict architectural/Black Hat reviews and evidence audit SHALL report actual results and unresolved findings.
Final release evidence SHALL identify source, toolchain, dependencies, binaries, commands, exit status, workload, seeds and raw artifacts.
Local GPU work SHALL use the authorized OMP RTX 3090 route with skill-read evidence and parent verification; rejected candidates SHALL NOT be landed as accepted work.
Build/release CI SHALL check locked dependencies, SDK catalogs, schemas, formatting, warnings, behavior, migrations, dependency audit and reproducible artifacts.
Tests against PostgreSQL SHALL exercise its actual concurrency/locking/isolation semantics rather than substitute SQLite-only results.
Emulation SHALL preserve SDK protocol/signing behavior and distinguish fixture assertions from real-AWS qualification.
Production qualification SHALL include staged real-account validation and a multi-day continuous soak before thousand-account rollout.
Documentation SHALL include installation, onboarding, supported coverage, daily use, failure recovery, API/schema compatibility and safe upgrades.
Cold inventory, steady change processing, hourly reconciliation, API queries, rendering and cost SHALL be benchmarked separately and together under contention.
Benchmarks SHALL freeze coverage/fields/freshness/durability/quotas/hardware/versions before comparisons and validate state equality.
Comparisons SHALL include Steampipe cold/warm behavior and CloudQuery full/incremental/supported event-driven behavior where equivalent.
Interactive indexed lookup/filter/one-hop queries SHALL target p95 at most 250 ms and p99 at most 1 second on the declared 10-million-asset profile.
Accepted supported change processing SHALL target 99.9 percent within five seconds during the declared healthy steady load, with every miss visible and provider delivery measured separately.
The system SHALL measure hourly full reconciliation concurrently with event processing, UI/API traffic and projection work.
Performance evidence SHALL include min/median/variance, sufficient tail samples, resource/cost use, throttles, coverage and freshness rather than peak rows/s alone.
Optimizations SHALL follow measured profiles and preserve correctness, coverage, observability and durability on before/after workloads.
Market-leading claims SHALL name the workload, measured competitors, versions and confidence; a local stage result SHALL NOT establish a market-wide ranking.
A release SHALL remain a candidate until required evidence and independent reviews pass; known rejected findings SHALL NOT be silently reclassified as approval.
